the proposed architecture is capable to implement FIR filters with a low power consumption, high throughput and a low area consumption.

the development of low-power, high-performance, VLSI architectures for FIR filters.
the design of low power, high performance FIR filters for reconfigurable VHSIC hardware.
the development of a low-power VLSI architecture, which is capable of implementing FIR filters.
